text:
From the moment I first saw you on 14-04-2017, something in me changed forever. I didn’t know your name, I didn’t know who you were. That moment—just seeing you board the bus—felt like my whole life suddenly found its purpose. From that day, you have lived in my heart without even knowing it.

All these years, through every temple trip we took together, every small moment—my love for you only grew. I didn’t even realise how deep it had gone until the day I started missing you so much that it hurt.

I searched for you for years. Just your name and your face… that was enough for me to keep looking. Finding you in Social Media after two whole years felt like destiny giving me one more chance.

Even when you didn’t remember me in the beginning… Even when you asked us to stay “just friends”… My heart never changed. Not once. Not even for a second. I know you may not feel the same. I know you said you regret not being able to return the love I give you.

But please understand this — I never loved you because I wanted something back. I love you because you are you. Your smile, your existence… Every part of you is precious to me. You are the only girl I will and I have ever loved in my entire life. And even today, after all these years, after all the distance, after all the silence — my heart still beats the same way it did when I saw you for the very first time.

This website… this project… every small thing I make… It’s all because you deserve something beautiful. You always have. You always will.

section: My Best wishes / My Dearest V
text: From the moment I first saw you, my world has carried your smile, your voice, and your presence in its every corner. You’ve been shaping my life without even knowing it. So today, on your special day, I pray that every dream you hold finds its way to you gently… that life gives you more love, more peace, and more reasons to smile.

section: My Best wishes / Happy Birthday Miss
text: On your birthday, I don’t want to wish you the usual things. I want to wish you a kind of happiness that stays with you quietly, like a soft light in your heart… the kind that never leaves you, even on the days when life feels heavy.

Happy Birthday, my girl. I don’t know what the future holds, but I know one thing with all my heart: my life will always carry your name in every heart beat inside me. You deserve nothing less. And I may not be the one beside you right now but, you’ll always be the one inside my heart. Happy Birthday, the girl I’ve loved since the very first glance. Always yours, quietly and endlessly.

From that day, my heart has belonged to you in a way words can never fully explain.

section: The Day My Heart Chose You
text:
The Day My Heart Chose You

The first moment I saw you stepping into that bus. I didn’t know anything about you.

You were just a girl boarding a bus… but to me, that moment was the beginning of a new universe. I still remember praying silently, wishing somehow you would sit near me, wishing just to be close. That first glance wasn’t just a memory — it is the moment that built my entire life’s purpose.

From that day, my heart has belonged to you in a way words can never fully explain.

Falling in love with you was never a moment… it was a feeling that kept growing every single time I saw you. Your eyes, the way they light up when you smile, the little laugh lines when you’re truly happy — those things made my heart fall even deeper without me even knowing.

Every time I saw you, I felt like the world paused for a second just to let me breathe you in.

And that day you said, “You deserve better”? Better than what, madam? Because for me, there is no “better”. There is only you.

From the first day I saw you in that bus in 2017 till this moment, you are the only girl my heart has ever chosen, and the only one it will choose for the rest of my life.

You are not someone I want to replace. You are someone I want to protect, cherish, and love forever — exactly as you are.

My life carries so many weights—responsibilities, worries, unspoken thoughts. There are days when my mind feels lost, my heart feels heavy, and the world around me feels too loud to handle.

But then… there is you. Just the smallest thought of you changes everything. When I see you in the morning, my day suddenly finds meaning again. And when life feels dull or lonely, I open my gallery, look at your picture, and in a single second—I feel calm again.

You’re not just someone passing through my story. You’re the reason the story feels beautiful at all.

And that little 2-second audio clip of you—the one I found by accident but my heart immediately recognized—it became my alarm, my playlist, my favorite sound in this world. And when you finally confirmed it was really your voice, my whole heart bloomed.

I felt proud of my love, because deep down my heart already knew you. That’s how strongly I feel you. That's how deeply my heart believes in you.

If my heart was a museum, every wall would be filled with stories of you...

The memories, the moments, the wishes, the dreams, the prayers I made silently, all the little things you’ll never know… Every corner of my heart has your name on it. Every feeling inside me started with you. You are the most priceless masterpiece in my entire life.

The only photos I have with you—even if they’re AI-generated—are precious to me. They show a world I wish to live in — a world where standing beside you is normal, not rare.

I’ve written posts, made edits, created a page, saved memories, built a website…

But the biggest thing I’ve ever done is simple: I loved you — truly, purely, constantly.

Even when I was scared. Even when I didn’t know if you remembered me. Even when we were not talking. Even when we were “just friends.” Even when I had no chance…

My love never changed. It never reduced. It never faded.

Everything I’ve ever created — page, posts, messages — came from one place: pure love. Everything I’ve done — big or small — is just a reflection of how deeply my heart is connected to you. I never did them expecting anything. I did them because loving you makes me feel alive.

section: Ever wonder - what you mean to me
text:
I know I’m not perfect. I get confused, and I’m still learning what love truly means. But one thing I know for sure is this...I will never leave you.

No matter how many years pass… No matter how heavy my heart feels… No matter how much it hurts to know you may never be mine…

With every ache, every hope, and every drop of love inside me, I keep falling for you even more.

I want to be the person who brings you every happiness in the world. I may not always know how to heal your pain or fix your bad days, but I will stand beside you through all of it—quietly, patiently, lovingly—until you heal.

My love is not about being perfect. It is about being loyal. Being present. Choosing you again and again, even when you don’t choose me.

Because from the very first moment I saw you… it was always you.
